n10ab1e7c5a.headline: Khalifa bin Zayed approves the largest legislative changes in the history of the state
n10ab1e7c5a.summary: Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan approved the largest federal legislative reforms in UAE history aimed at enhancing the economic environment, investment infrastructure, and social stability.
n10ab1e7c5a.why: Legislative reforms can improve the business climate and attract investment, impacting the UAE's economic growth and regional competitiveness.
